title: Tail Tier World Reactions
description: Defines how the game world responds to Kai-Jax's tail progression. This makes tail tiers systemically meaningful, not just visual.

rules.application: All world systems (AI, music, NPCs, environment) MUST respond to current_tail_count
rules.enforcement: Build-time validation ensures these reactions are wired into game systems

3.description: Starting form. World sees potential but not yet proven power.

enemy_behavior.notes: Enemies engage cautiously but don't flee. Standard combat behavior.

music_intensity.notes: Grounded combat theme. No triumphant elements yet.

npc_reactions.notes: NPCs treat player as competent warrior, not legend.

world_state.notes: World acknowledges player exists but hasn't changed because of them.

4.description: First evolution. World begins to take notice.

enemy_behavior.notes: Weaker enemies show hesitation when player is aggressive.

music_intensity.notes: Percussion becomes more prominent. Hints of power theme.

npc_reactions.notes: NPCs acknowledge player is becoming dangerous.

world_state.notes: World systems begin to adapt to player presence.

5.description: Mid-evolution. Enemies must adapt tactics or die.

enemy_behavior.notes: Fodder enemies actively avoid 1v1. Elites use team tactics.

music_intensity.notes: Full combat theme with heroic brass. Player is a battlefield force.

npc_reactions.notes: NPCs keep physical distance. Some begin hero worship.

world_state.notes: World reacts to player as a war-changing asset.

6.description: High evolution. Player presence changes battlefield dynamics.

enemy_behavior.notes: Fodder enemies run. Elites fight defensively. Bosses recognize threat.

music_intensity.notes: Music shifts to legendary hero theme. Combat is expected victory.

npc_reactions.notes: NPCs treat player as living legend. Some shrines appear.

world_state.notes: World systems treat player as a force of nature.

7.description: Near-final evolution. Few can stand against the player.

enemy_behavior.notes: Only bosses and scripted encounters engage willingly.

music_intensity.notes: Music reinforces player as unstoppable. Combat is execution.

npc_reactions.notes: NPCs build altars. Some factions seek alliance at any cost.

world_state.notes: World knows the player is approaching final confrontation.

8.description: One tail from godhood. The world holds its breath.

enemy_behavior.notes: Only final bosses with reality-warping powers remain as threats.

music_intensity.notes: Music becomes otherworldly. Combat theme merges with cosmic dread.

npc_reactions.notes: NPCs treat player as ascending god. Some lose sanity.

world_state.notes: World systems struggle to process player's existence.

9.description: Final form. Kai-Jax complete. The world bends.

enemy_behavior.notes: No organic enemy encounters. Only story-mandated final bosses remain.

music_intensity.notes: Music becomes pure power. Combat theme is victory incarnate.

npc_reactions.notes: NPCs cannot process player. Dialogue system breaks intentionally.

world_state.notes: World systems recognize player as complete. Game approaches finale.

implementation_notes.enemy_ai: Must check current_tail_count and apply behavior from this file. No hardcoded values.
implementation_notes.music_system: Must dynamically layer tracks based on tier. Transitions should be smooth.
implementation_notes.npc_dialogue: Must check tail_count and select dialogue trees accordingly. Fear/worship affects shop prices.
implementation_notes.world_state: Environmental systems (spawns, events) must reference tier descriptor.
implementation_notes.validation: Build system must verify all references to tail tiers use this file as source of truth.
